(अंग्रेज़ी), एम.एड. श्रीमती मधु प्रसाद ने केंद्रीय विद्यालय, अहमदाबाद कैंट में अंग्रेज़ी की प्रशिक्षित स्नातक शिक्षिका के रूप में तीन दशकों से अधिक समय तक अध्यापन किया और 2016 में सेवानिवृत्त हुईं। चार दशकों से अधिक समय से साहित्य-सृजन में सक्रिय हैं। उनकी 11 पुस्तकें प्रकाशित हैं, जिनमें नौ काव्य-संग्रह, एक गद्य-संग्रह एवं एक संपादित कृति शामिल हैं। गीत, नवगीत, कविता, दोहा, हाइकु, कहानी, संस्मरण, साक्षात्कार एवं समीक्षा उनकी प्रमुख रचनात्मक विधाएँ हैं। उनकी रचनाएँ 50 से अधिक साझा संकलनों में प्रकाशित हुई हैं। केंद्रीय विद्यालय संगठन विशिष्ट सेवा सम्मान (2015) तथा हिंदी गौरव’ सम्मान, सिंगापुर (2020)* सहित अनेक सम्मान प्राप्त। स्वतंत्र लेखन एवं साहित्यिक आयोजनों में निरंतर सक्रिय।

b: Speaker. Madhumitha Anavaratham is an entrepreneur, children’s author, music creator and education strategist working at the intersection of technology, education, publishing and creativity. At Agnira Research Labs, she…
f: Speaker. Madhumitha Anavaratham is an entrepreneur, children’s author, music creator and education strategist working at the intersection of technology, education, publishing and creativity. At Agnira Research Labs, she explores AI, human cognition and learning. She is also Director at Consilium 7 Publishing and a founding member of the Foundation for Ed-Equity. Her work is driven by a fascination with how children think, read, imagine and create in an increasingly technology-driven world.

b: Speaker. With over three and a half decades of distinguished public service, Manoj Aggarwal, IAS (Retd.), is a former Gujarat Cadre officer who retired in 2024 as Additional Chief Secretary – Health, Government of…
f: Speaker. With over three and a half decades of distinguished public service, Manoj Aggarwal, IAS (Retd.), is a former Gujarat Cadre officer who retired in 2024 as Additional Chief Secretary – Health, Government of Gujarat. During his career, he served as DDO at Rajkot and Jamnagar, Collector at Godhra and Panchmahals, Managing Director of GMDC and GIDC, and held important assignments with the Government of India in New Delhi. His rich administrative experience and deep understanding of governance, leadership and public policy bring valuable perspectives to literary and cultural dialogue. He is currently honorary mentor of Ahmedabad International Literature Festival.

b: Sri Lankan Journalist and Media Professional Meedum Ransara is a Sri Lankan journalist and media communication professional with experience in television journalism, digital media, and development communication. She has…
f: Sri Lankan Journalist and Media Professional Meedum Ransara is a Sri Lankan journalist and media communication professional with experience in television journalism, digital media, and development communication. She has served as a Media Officer with the Sri Lankan Human Rights Commission under a UNDP-supported project and worked as a News Anchor and Senior Web News Editor with leading Sri Lankan news channels. She holds a B.A. (Honours) in Sinhala Language, Literature and Cultural Studies from the University of Peradeniya.

b: Speaker. Minal Dave is a well-known Gujarati short-story writer and an eminent translator. She is highly recognized for translating acclaimed South Indian literature into Gujarati, most notably books like Godhuli and…
f: Speaker. Minal Dave is a well-known Gujarati short-story writer and an eminent translator. She is highly recognized for translating acclaimed South Indian literature into Gujarati, most notably books like Godhuli and Swechchha. A former Associate Professor of Gujarati Literature, she is currently retired. In recognition of her exceptional work in bringing South Indian languages to Gujarati readers, she was honored with the prestigious Sahitya Academy (Delhi) Translation Prize.

b: Speaker. Neha R. Krishna is a Mumbai-based poet, translator, and new-age media professional. She worked with Academy Award-winning writer and lyricist Gulzar , translating his Triveni poems into English tanka for a…
f: Speaker. Neha R. Krishna is a Mumbai-based poet, translator, and new-age media professional. She worked with Academy Award-winning writer and lyricist Gulzar , translating his Triveni poems into English tanka for a volume published by Penguin India. She is the author of No Urgency to Be Home and currently works with Kuku TV, shaping India’s emerging micro drama landscape. Her poetry has been featured at leading literary festivals, including Sahitya Academy Festival, Delhi Poetry Festival, Kaafiya Festival, and Cuttack Literature Festival.

b: Vietnamese Artist and Scholar. Nguyen Kim Phuong is a Vietnamese artist and scholar pursuing an M.A. in Archaeology and Ancient History at Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda under an ICCR scholarship. A graduate in…
f: Vietnamese Artist and Scholar. Nguyen Kim Phuong is a Vietnamese artist and scholar pursuing an M.A. in Archaeology and Ancient History at Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda under an ICCR scholarship. A graduate in Art and Design from the Vietnam University of Fine Arts, she has worked as an artist, art educator and consultant. Her research explores the enduring cultural connections between South and Southeast Asia. She has done some of researches like Shaivism in India, Vietnam etc. Through art, archaeology and cultural research, she seeks to illuminate shared Asian heritage and envision India as a bridge connecting diverse Asian civilizations. She is the founder of Kim Phuong Art Studio as well.

b: Media Professional | Writer | Columnist | Communicator. Nilesh Dholakia is a dynamic media professional, writer and communicator with over 30 years of experience across media, communications and entertainment. He began…
f: Media Professional | Writer | Columnist | Communicator. Nilesh Dholakia is a dynamic media professional, writer and communicator with over 30 years of experience across media, communications and entertainment. He began his career with Akashvani, Mumbai, as a news reader and announcer, and later associated with television, including Zee TV’s Chakravyuh. He has worked with reputed organisations including The Times Group, Mint, Hindustan Times, Delhi Press and The Indian Express, with expertise in media promotion, circulation, sales, PR, networking and events. A columnist and versatile media personality, he has also participated in television, films, stage programmes and anchoring. He currently hosts the podcast series “Maanas Chhe Malava Jeva.”

b: Speaker. Volga (P. Lalitha Kumari) is a highly acclaimed Telugu poet, novelist, and pioneering feminist writer. A former Telugu professor and senior film scriptwriter, she seamlessly bridges the worlds of academia,…
f: Speaker. Volga (P. Lalitha Kumari) is a highly acclaimed Telugu poet, novelist, and pioneering feminist writer. A former Telugu professor and senior film scriptwriter, she seamlessly bridges the worlds of academia, cinema, and literature. She was honored with the prestigious Sahitya Akademi Award in 2015 for her celebrated short story collection 'Vimukta'. For decades, her powerful voice has deeply influenced contemporary Indian literature.

(pen name 'Awara Banjara') Banker turned Travel Yogi l StoryTeller l Educator He has explored ~150000+ KMs (~twelve times of the earth's diameter) spanning 150+ towns touching all of the 28 States | 8 Union Territories of Incredible India. Currently, a Phd Research Scholar (Wellness Tourism), he synthesizes Vedantic Wisdom, Yogic Body and Ayurvedic Lifestyle with varied - Travel l Academia l Entrepreneurial | Corporate experiences to guide one's journey towards 'Anandam (Joyfulness)'. Prakash is an MBA (FMS Delhi) & an Engineer (NIT Durgapur) with ~10 years of professional experience across Standard Chartered Bank, HSBC, Yes Bank & Infosys Tech Ltd.

f: Speaker. પ્રાંજલ કશ્યપ અમદાવાદ સ્થિત જાણીતા ક્રિએટિવ રાઇટર, સ્ક્રિપ્ટરાઇટર અને ક્રિએટિવ એજન્સી ‘કન્ટેન્ટ કાસલ’ (Content Castle) ના સ્થાપક છે. તેઓ ભાષાકીય અભિવ્યક્તિ, પટકથા લેખન, રેડિયો પ્રોડક્શન અને બ્રાન્ડ સ્ટોરીટેલિંગના ક્ષેત્રમાં સક્રિયપણે કાર્યરત છે. ઓલ ઈન્ડિયા રેડિયો (આકાશવાણી) ખાતે આશરે ત્રણ વર્ષ સુધી એનાઉન્સર/પ્રસ્તુતકર્તા તરીકે સેવાઓ આપી છે. તથા કાવ્ય પઠન, સાહિત્યિક ઇવેન્ટ્સ અને સાંસ્કૃતિક મંચો (જેમ કે ‘અભિવ્યક્તિ સિટી આર્ટ્સ પ્રોજેક્ટ’) પર એન્કરિંગ અને સાહિત્યિક પ્રોજેક્ટ્સમાં પણ ઘણા જ સક્રિય છે.

b: Professor | Information Systems | Management Educator IIM Ahmedabad. Prof. Sanjay Verma is a distinguished faculty member at IIM Ahmedabad, specialising in Information Systems and Marketing . A Fellow of IIM Calcutta,…
f: Professor | Information Systems | Management Educator IIM Ahmedabad. Prof. Sanjay Verma is a distinguished faculty member at IIM Ahmedabad, specialising in Information Systems and Marketing . A Fellow of IIM Calcutta, his research interests include Management Information Systems, Knowledge Management, E-Governance, Business Intelligence and organisational performance. He has contributed extensively to management education through academic and executive programmes and serves as Chairperson of the Armed Forces Programme , supporting the transition of armed forces professionals into the corporate sector. He has also served on the boards of Punjab & Sind Bank, Punjab National Bank and IIM Rohtak , bringing together expertise in technology, management, governance and organisational transformation.

b: Speaker. Roshni Sinha began dancing at the age of six, later refining her craft under the strict guidance of Guru Nilmoni Singha. Beautifully blending the discipline of Manipuri classical dance with the emotional…
f: Speaker. Roshni Sinha began dancing at the age of six, later refining her craft under the strict guidance of Guru Nilmoni Singha. Beautifully blending the discipline of Manipuri classical dance with the emotional expression of Rabindra Nritya, her performances are a masterclass in cultural storytelling. Currently representing Bangladesh in India as an ICCR Scholar for the academic year 2024–25, she balances her artistic passion with academics, pursuing her Honors degree in English Literature right here at Gujarat University.

b: Speaker. Young Heritage Advocate | Student Founder, Amdavadi Roots | Aspiring Socio-Cultural Entrepreneur Rudraditya Parth Panchal is a young heritage advocate and emerging entrepreneur passionate about connecting the…
f: Speaker. Young Heritage Advocate | Student Founder, Amdavadi Roots | Aspiring Socio-Cultural Entrepreneur Rudraditya Parth Panchal is a young heritage advocate and emerging entrepreneur passionate about connecting the younger generation with the cultural identity, history, and living traditions of Ahmedabad. His interest in heritage has evolved into a commitment to making cultural awareness more engaging, accessible, and relevant to young people. As the founder of Amdavadi Roots, Rudraditya initiated a student-led heritage awareness campaign, “My City, My Pride,” to encourage students to discover Ahmedabad beyond its familiar landmarks and develop a deeper appreciation of its historical legacy. His vision is to inspire young citizens to take pride in their city's identity, explore its stories, and participate meaningfully in heritage awareness and preservation. Through youth engagement, heritage walks, digital storytelling, and collaborative learning, he hopes to create a bridge between the city's rich past and its future generations. Rudraditya aspires to develop Amdavadi Roots into a youth-led heritage community that encourages students to become cultural storytellers, responsible heritage ambassadors, and active contributors to their communities. His larger vision is to take the initiative beyond Ahmedabad, connecting young people across India and eventually the world through shared stories of culture, identity, and heritage. Currently pursuing his academic journey in Marketing and Entrepreneurship, Rudraditya is keen to explore how business innovation, branding, digital media, and social entrepreneurship can support cultural initiatives. He envisions building a sustainable heritage-focused enterprise that creates opportunities for young people while supporting local artisans, heritage educators, cultural institutions, and community-led tourism. For Rudraditya, heritage is not merely a legacy to inherit; it is a responsibility to understand, share, and carry forward. His ambition is to demonstrate how young leadership and entrepreneurial thinking can transform cultural appreciation into meaningful social impact.

b: Cultural Activist and Change Maker. Rutwi Patel is a social change maker, cultural activist, and Mahamantri of Rashtradharma Pratishtan and President of Vision Foundation, Gandhinagar. With a Master’s degree in Mass…
f: Cultural Activist and Change Maker. Rutwi Patel is a social change maker, cultural activist, and Mahamantri of Rashtradharma Pratishtan and President of Vision Foundation, Gandhinagar. With a Master’s degree in Mass Communication and Journalism, she has worked with the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India, for over 17 years, engaging with thousands of young people through nation-building initiatives. She has directed, choreographed, and performed in more than 450 stage and theatre productions in India and abroad. A recipient of the Youth Leader Award, Lok Kala Rashtriya Gaurav Puraskar, and Samajik Seva Samman Puraskar, she currently leads initiatives including Bharat 2047 – A Mission With Vision, Yuva Jagaran Abhiyan, Sakshama Abhiyan, and Indradhanush.

b: Author | Retired Teacher | Poet. A retired teacher, Mrs S. Kaur Chowdhury rediscovered her passion for writing at 82 while recovering from a heart procedure, finding healing and purpose in words. She is the author of…
f: Author | Retired Teacher | Poet. A retired teacher, Mrs S. Kaur Chowdhury rediscovered her passion for writing at 82 while recovering from a heart procedure, finding healing and purpose in words. She is the author of two books: From My Heart, reflections on the many places she lived during her daughter's postings, and Awesome Assam, her journey as a young Punjabi bride embracing Assam's culture and charm. Now settled in Ahmedabad, she is living proof that passion knows no age.

b: Actor. Sandeep Yadav is a talented actor in Indian cinema who began his acting journey with Hindi theatre. He received training through theatre workshops at BNA and NSD and worked for six years under the direction of…
f: Actor. Sandeep Yadav is a talented actor in Indian cinema who began his acting journey with Hindi theatre. He received training through theatre workshops at BNA and NSD and worked for six years under the direction of the legendary theatre maestro Habib Tanvir, honoured with the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan. He holds a Master’s degree in Theatre from Swarrnim Himalaya University (as provided: Sparsh Himalaya University). His film credits include acclaimed productions such as Peepli Live, Batla House, Thappad, Satyameva Jayate 2, Bhagwat, and Ek Chatur Naar. His notable web series include Hasmukh, Bhaukaal, and Aashram. He is currently associated with several major Bollywood projects, continuing to showcase his versatility and passion for acting.

b: Screenwriter, Director and Columnist. Sanjay Chhel is a highly popular and multifaceted name in Indian cinema and Gujarati literature. Along with being a successful film writer and director, he is widely known for his…
f: Screenwriter, Director and Columnist. Sanjay Chhel is a highly popular and multifaceted name in Indian cinema and Gujarati literature. Along with being a successful film writer and director, he is widely known for his popular weekly newspaper column, 'Mijaj Masti'. The writer behind the dialogues of Bollywood hits like 'Rangeela' and the director of films like 'Khoobsurat', Sanjay Chhel is celebrated for his unique, witty, and humorous style of presenting even the most serious topics.

b: Speaker. SANJAY 'KRISHNNA is a graduate of JNU, New Delhi and has a master’s in English literature. 'Silence is Fatal', his debut book, was published in 2019 followed by a novel titled ‘Love, Lust and Avarice’.…
f: Speaker. SANJAY 'KRISHNNA is a graduate of JNU, New Delhi and has a master’s in English literature. 'Silence is Fatal', his debut book, was published in 2019 followed by a novel titled ‘Love, Lust and Avarice’. ‘Vairagya Vasna Utsarg’ was his first novel in Hindi. His latest work is titled ‘Bindaas Butterfly and The Boundaries’. His writings reveal the lesser-known facets of human nature, their impact on the individual and the society at large, as also the growing need to address the ills that plague them both. The author can be reached at: majorsanjay7@gmail.com

b: Speaker. Sekou Kante is an English teacher from Mali, pursuing an M.A. in English Literature at Gujarat University under the ICCR programme. He has taught English in government junior high schools in Koutiala, southern…
f: Speaker. Sekou Kante is an English teacher from Mali, pursuing an M.A. in English Literature at Gujarat University under the ICCR programme. He has taught English in government junior high schools in Koutiala, southern Mali, since 2013. He has also worked as Partnership Liaison Manager for a U.S.-based NGO implementing a library project for school students in Koutiala. Passionate about teaching, literature, and cultural exchange, he hopes to connect teachers and lovers of English language and literature in Mali with the Ahmedabad International Literature Festival.

b: Performer. Serene Yadav is a Class IX student with a keen interest in Odissi, English literature, and history. She has been learning the classical dance form of Odissi at Sudha Institute of Dance under the guidance of…
f: Performer. Serene Yadav is a Class IX student with a keen interest in Odissi, English literature, and history. She has been learning the classical dance form of Odissi at Sudha Institute of Dance under the guidance of Guru P. Sudharani. For over two years, she has been performing as part of her dance group at the Ahmedabad International Literature Festival (AILF) and various other cultural programmes. Balancing her academic pursuits with her passion for the performing arts, Serene continues to explore the richness of Indian classical dance and the joy of artistic expression.

b: Young Odissi Dancer. Shreeja Ray, an 11-year-old student of Class VI at Delhi Public School (DPS), Bopal, Ahmedabad, is a promising classical dancer training under Guru Smt. P. Sudharani. A scholarship recipient of…
f: Young Odissi Dancer. Shreeja Ray, an 11-year-old student of Class VI at Delhi Public School (DPS), Bopal, Ahmedabad, is a promising classical dancer training under Guru Smt. P. Sudharani. A scholarship recipient of CCRT, Ministry of Culture, Government of India, she has performed at prestigious platforms, including the Somnath All India National Art and Cultural Festival, Kala Mahakumbh, Odissi International Festival in Odisha, ASIA, and the Ahmedabad International Literature Festival 2025. Her achievements include first position at the Northern Zone district level and Somnath, third at the state level and Rajkot, and second at the ASIA International Odissi Dance Festival 2025.

A former RJ, she has also worked on national and international events and remains actively involved in literary and cultural spaces. Her interests span literature, storytelling, popular culture, and the ways in which stories shape how we understand people and the world around us.

She has collaborated with leading fashion and lifestyle brands, working alongside established makeup artists and creative teams to build a strong presence in the fashion and beauty space. b: Tanvi Dave is a third-year B.Tech student with a deep appreciation for literature, language, and the many ways stories bring people together. As the Secretary of her college’s Literature Club, she finds herself drawn to…
f: Tanvi Dave is a third-year B.Tech student with a deep appreciation for literature, language, and the many ways stories bring people together. b: Entrepreneur | Filmmaker | Author | Poet | Cultural Visionary | Indian Air Force Veteran. Umashanker Yadav is a multifaceted Indian entrepreneur, filmmaker, author, poet and cultural visionary whose journey reflects the…
f: Entrepreneur | Filmmaker | Author | Poet | Cultural Visionary | Indian Air Force Veteran. Umashanker Yadav is a multifaceted Indian entrepreneur, filmmaker, author, poet and cultural visionary whose journey reflects the values of discipline, perseverance, creativity and nation-building. Coming from a rural family with an agricultural background, Umashanker demonstrated academic excellence from an early age. After securing the first position in his college during High School, he qualified for mechanical engineering through the UP Polytechnic Entrance Examination. However, he chose a different path, leaving engineering in his second year to join the Indian Air Force in 1985. He served the Indian Air Force for 15 years in the Electronics stream, an experience that instilled in him discipline, technical competence, self-reliance and a deep sense of commitment. These values subsequently became the foundation of his entrepreneurial and creative pursuits. His academic journey is equally diverse. He holds a Master of Arts in English from Jai Narain Vyas University, Jodhpur , an MBA in Marketing , and a Postgraduate Diploma in Journalism and Mass Communication from Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) . His academic qualifications, combined with his professional experience, have contributed to his multidisciplinary approach to business, literature, communication and cinema. Following his service in the Air Force, Umashanker ventured into entrepreneurship and founded several organisations, including Ikon Barcode Solutions, Ikon Label Industries, Serene Publishers and Serene Films. Through these initiatives, he has pursued his belief in building sustainable enterprises with integrity, dignity and a larger social purpose. A writer and poet, he authored Beyond Dreamz , reflecting his belief in dreams, possibilities and the courage to pursue one's aspirations. His passion for literature and cultural exchange led him to establish the Ahmedabad International Literature Festival (AILF) in 2016, an initiative of the Ikon Education Foundation. As its Founder Director and Managing Director, he has nurtured AILF into one of India's prestigious literature festivals, bringing together writers, poets, filmmakers, academicians, journalists and cultural voices from India and across the world. The festival provides a platform for dialogue, intellectual engagement and the celebration of literature, art and culture. His association with cinema reflects another dimension of his creative journey. He is the Story and Script Writer, Producer and Actor of the Hindi feature film Drop Out , which had its theatrical release on 29 May 2026 and is now streaming on Amazon Prime Video and BookMyShow Stream. His other film credits include Heer & Ranjha (Actor and Producer) and Sukhnath Mogra Ni Varta (Co-Producer). Umashanker believes that entrepreneurship should create not merely wealth but also opportunities, meaningful employment and a positive contribution to society. His philosophy is rooted in integrity, purpose and the desire to create something that outlives him. His journey, spanning national service, academic pursuits, entrepreneurship, literature and cinema, reflects a continuing commitment to transforming dreams into meaningful initiatives and creating a lasting social and cultural impact.

b: Writer and Director. Umesh Shukla is an acclaimed Indian filmmaker, writer, director, and actor with deep roots in Gujarati theatre. He rose to national prominence with OMG – Oh My God! a thought-provoking satire that…
f: Writer and Director. Umesh Shukla is an acclaimed Indian filmmaker, writer, director, and actor with deep roots in Gujarati theatre. He rose to national prominence with OMG – Oh My God! a thought-provoking satire that explored faith, religion, and society, earning him the National Film Award for Best Adapted Screenplay. His notable directorial works include Dhoondte Reh Jaaoge , All Is Well , 102 Not Out , and Aankh Micholi . Known for blending humour with meaningful social themes, Shukla brings compelling storytelling and a distinctive perspective to contemporary Indian cinema.

b: Speaker. V. S. Gadhvi, IAS (Retd.) is a distinguished former Gujarat-cadre civil servant with an extensive career in public administration and governance. During his service, he held several senior positions, including…
f: Speaker. V. S. Gadhvi, IAS (Retd.) is a distinguished former Gujarat-cadre civil servant with an extensive career in public administration and governance. During his service, he held several senior positions, including Principal Secretary, Revenue; Secretary, Water Supply; Chairman, Gujarat Water Supply Board; Managing Director, Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation (GMDC); and Managing Director, Gujarat State Financial Corporation (GSFC). He later served as an Information Commissioner and Chief Information Commissioner of Gujarat. With rich experience across administration, development, public institutions and governance, he brings deep insight into public policy, society and the functioning of government institutions.

b: Writer, Producer and Lyricist. Vaibhav Modi is a writer, producer and former broadcaster with over 25 years of experience across film, television and streaming. He has worked with leading Indian networks and studios and…
f: Writer, Producer and Lyricist. Vaibhav Modi is a writer, producer and former broadcaster with over 25 years of experience across film, television and streaming. He has worked with leading Indian networks and studios and now develops and produces his own content. He wrote and produced Mukhbir, the espionage series based on Maloy Krishna Dhar’s writing, and has also worked on the music format Times of Music. His work has received the Filmfare OTT Award, Asia Academy Creative Award and Screenwriters Association Award. A poet as well, Vaibhav returned to ghazal writing with Sar-e-Shaam, sung by Papon. At AILF 2026, he brings his perspective on writing, poetry, storytelling and the many forms in which words create joy.

b: Speaker. A Class IX student at Udgam School for Children, Ahmedabad Vartika Rao is a passionate reader with a special love for English Literature. She enjoys discovering new worlds through books, exploring diverse…
f: Speaker. A Class IX student at Udgam School for Children, Ahmedabad Vartika Rao is a passionate reader with a special love for English Literature. She enjoys discovering new worlds through books, exploring diverse perspectives, and appreciating the beauty and power of words. When she isn’t immersed in a book, Vartika loves drawing—a creative pursuit that allows her imagination to come alive on paper. Her twin passions for literature and art reflect her curiosity, creativity, and love for self-expression. With an inquisitive mind and a creative spirit, Vartika is always eager to learn, explore, and express. She looks forward to continuing her journey as a young reader, artist, and storyteller.

b: Speaker. Vasundhara Panchal, CENTA National Topper, is an educator, researcher and teacher trainer with 20+ years’ experience in teaching, curriculum development and communication. Pursuing doctoral research on youth,…
f: Speaker. Vasundhara Panchal, CENTA National Topper, is an educator, researcher and teacher trainer with 20+ years’ experience in teaching, curriculum development and communication. Pursuing doctoral research on youth, cultural heritage and education, she champions experiential learning, heritage awareness and youth engagement, fostering collaborations with educational institutions, museums, universities and CSR initiatives to transform cultural learning into meaningful community participation.

b: Hotelier & Restaurateur | Luxury Hospitality & Asset Management. Vikram Aditya Singh is a hospitality leader with 28 years of global experience across luxury hotels, resorts and restaurants. Known for transforming…
f: Hotelier & Restaurateur | Luxury Hospitality & Asset Management. Vikram Aditya Singh is a hospitality leader with 28 years of global experience across luxury hotels, resorts and restaurants. Known for transforming underperforming and complex assets, he has delivered 5× RevPAR turnarounds, including at The Lodhi, New Delhi, which achieved Condé Nast Traveler’s World’s #2 Hotel ranking. In the Maldives, he delivered 41% RevPAR outperformance against leading luxury competitors. He has also led significant turnarounds at Campton Place, San Francisco, and The Claridges. Currently Director of Assets at The Ummed Ahmedabad, he brings expertise in asset repositioning, financial strategy, revenue and operations. He holds an MBA from EHL Lausanne and Master Certificates from Cornell.

b: IT expert and management consultant. Vision Raval is an enterprise strategist and digital transformation leader with over 22 years of experience scaling organizations through intelligent automation and process…
f: IT expert and management consultant. Vision Raval is an enterprise strategist and digital transformation leader with over 22 years of experience scaling organizations through intelligent automation and process excellence. Championing an automation-first mindset, he specializes in deploying applied AI, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), and Business Process Improvement (BPI) frameworks that translate complex operations into lean, high-output business models. His track record spans manufacturing, media, EduTech, WarTech, healthcare, IT, and government sectors—consistently delivering measurable ROI through intelligent decision systems, predictive analytics, and end-to-end operational modernization.

f: Director, Actor, and Filmmaker. Vivek Yadav is a Mumbai- and Lucknow-based casting director, actor, and filmmaker, with notable credits including Article 15, Bareilly Ki Barfi, Jolly LLB 2, Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana, and TVF’s Industry . His work on Article 15 earned a Best Ensemble Casting nomination at the FOI Online Awards. His recent film Drop Out under SERENE FILMS saw him contribute as Casting Director, Executive Producer, and Actor . He is the founder of Rayvik Pictures Pvt. Ltd. and a Founding Member of the Lucknow Film Festival .

b: Speaker. Wing Commander Arun Kaul spent his school years in St. Xaviers, Jaipur. He is a post graduate in Literature from St. Stephens College, Delhi and in Management from the Faculty of Management Studies, Delhi.…
f: Speaker. Wing Commander Arun Kaul spent his school years in St. Xaviers, Jaipur. He is a post graduate in Literature from St. Stephens College, Delhi and in Management from the Faculty of Management Studies, Delhi. After a career in the Indian Air Force, he had been the Group Head-Human Resources in Arvind Mills, Ahmedabad followed by a stint in the healthcare industry. He lives in Ahmedabad, pursuing his passion of creative writing. Only One Life to Give is his first published complete work of non-fiction. Arun Kaul can be reached at www.arunkaul.com. Or write to him at arun54kaul@gmail.com.
